blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) were established on 2 October 1975 following the recommendations of the Narasimham Working Group.
The statutory backing for RRBs was provided by the Regional Rural Banks Act, 1976.
Prathama Bank in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, sponsored by Syndicate Bank, was the first RRB established in India.
RRBs are jointly owned by the Central Government, the concerned State Government, and the Sponsor Bank in a 50:15:35 ratio.
RRBs operate under the regulatory purview of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and are supervised by NABARD.
